{{Quote|Imperial spokespeople deny any wrongdoing in the assault on the ''Esseles''—|Communications feed overheard by [[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="The Old Republic—The Lost Suns 1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''assault on the ''Esseles''''', also known as the '''''Esseles'' incident''', was an operation under the command of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] carried out by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the objective of arresting [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Vyn Asara]] on charges of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]] and sedition against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. Grand [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] Kilran threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the entire crew of the ''[[Esseles (starship)|Esseles]]'' if they resisted his forces. Four individuals aboard the ''Esseles'' stood against the invaders, eventually repelling them and boarding the Moff's ship, disengaging the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] that held the ''Esseles'' and allowed it to escape. Following the assault, Imperial spokesmen denied any wrongdoing.
